note: ADR-0011 §3.2 first bars. Echo times exact to the sample, up to the longest note at the slowest tempo (1/1 at 20 BPM, 12 s); a host tempo under 20 BPM is bounded and reported. A time change is a 30 ms tap crossfade, so every automatable parameter is swept: times with sync off, note values and tempo with sync on.
